MCP OAuth tokens and provider/API Authorization headers

replay_script_identity_rule: Never replace the original validator hash with the sanitized script hash. If paths/SIDs are parameterized for public replay, preserve original->public script SHA mapping and describe it as a derived public copy. Prefer publishing original general verification entrypoints with explicit input manifests.
